title: Financial NER Engine — 金融实体识别引擎
description: Implement a Chinese financial Named Entity Recognition engine that recognizes 5 entity types (company, person, product, institution, metric) with surface form extraction, character offsets, confidence scoring, and company-to-ticker linking. The NER engine is a Wave 1 foundation dependency for F-037, F-042, F-038, and F-040. It MUST recognize A-share company names (full name, abbreviation, stock name), person names (analysts, executives, regulators), financial metrics (ROE, PE, PB, EPS), and link company entities to stock tickers via fuzzy matching.

criteria: 5 entity types recognized: [company, person, product, institution, metric]
NERResult frozen dataclass created with 7 fields: [surface_form, entity_type, start_offset, end_offset, confidence, linked_ticker, normalized_name]
Company ticker linking with fuzzy matching implemented
18+ unit tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_ner_engine.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True pattern
convergence.verification: py -m pytest tests/unit/test_ner_engine.py -p no:asyncio -q && ls synapse/nlp/ner*.py | wc -l
convergence.definition_of_done: NER engine recognizes 5 entity types in Chinese financial text with >90% accuracy on company names, links companies to tickers, and exposes a clean frozen dataclass API

Implement expand_abbreviations(text) -> str

implementation.title: Implement NEREngine core with ticker linking
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/ner_engine.py implementing NEREngine with recognize(text: TextDocument) -> NERResult. Engine chains: (1) company name dict lookup, (2) metric dict lookup, (3) person name pattern matching, (4) institution pattern matching (证监会/央行 etc.), (5) ticker linking via fuzzy match (difflib.SequenceMatcher).
modification_points: Implement NEREngine class with recognize() method
Implement fuzzy ticker linking (difflib or ratio-based)
logic_flow: Load dictionaries at __init__ (lazy)
Chain recognizers: company→metric→person→institution
Deduplicate overlapping spans (keep highest confidence)
Link company entities to tickers via fuzzy matching
Return NERResult with all entities and timing
